title: Keymap manifest
description: The published face of a mac app's keyboard map: effective bindings (registry defaults + user remaps), localized at write time. Written by the Keymap library (github.com/adriangalilea/swift-utils) to ~/Library/Application Support/untitled/keymaps/<bundle-id>.json on launch and on every remap; read by the system-wide shortcut overlay to display the frontmost app's keys. Combos are display strings in macOS glyph order ("⇧⌘K").

bundleID.description: The app's bundle identifier; also the manifest's filename.

accent.description: The app's accent color; the overlay tints per app.

local.description: In-app combos as display strings; first is the menu representative.
